description: Records a consultation booking after the user has paid the fee from their own bank app: name, phone, matter type, summary, the payment reference (UTR), and a preferred date and slot. Emails the booking to the firm (legal@unifiedchambers.com, with a copy to the Senior Partner’s mailbox) and an acknowledgement to the user. Does not make or verify any payment.

alt_slot.description: An alternative date and slot, if any

consent.description: The user agrees to the firm processing these details for the booking (DPDP Act, 2023)

name.description: Full name of the person attending the consultation

paid_on.description: Date the fee was paid, if known

phone.description: Phone number with country code, e.g. +91 98xxxxxxxx

slot_date.description: Preferred date, YYYY-MM-DD, not earlier than tomorrow (IST)

summary.description: What the matter is, in the user’s words (20–1500 characters)

utr.description: UTR / transaction reference from the bank or UPI app for the fee payment

name: book_consultation
title: Book a paid consultation
